clearedSpotChecks.check: L-1031 probe set on chain 999: the official endpoint answers like revm and reth, ECRECOVER priced at 15,000 gas, eth_call runs in a latest-plus-one context with a 30,000,000 gas limit, and none of the context differences reaches src/ because the PoolManager reads no NUMBER, TIMESTAMP, BLOCKHASH, BASEFEE, PREVRANDAO or GASPRICE and calls no precompile.
clearedSpotChecks.note: Rerun on 2026-11-26 against rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm (web3_clientVersion 'hyperliquid evm Mainnet'). eth_getCode of 0x12D4Fd9C5DeDd00ab8a0bCe2CF0167bbf94b6B1F returned 24,009 bytes; a linear disassembly that skips push data counts 0 BLOCKHASH, COINBASE, TIMESTAMP, NUMBER, PREVRANDAO, GASLIMIT, CHAINID, BASEFEE, GASPRICE, ORIGIN, BALANCE, DELEGATECALL, CREATE, CREATE2 and SELFDESTRUCT, and 1 SELFBALANCE, 5 GAS, 4 CALL, 1 STATICCALL, 20 TLOAD, 9 TSTORE, 2 MCOPY. eth_call of code NUMBER returned 0x31df6e4 while eth_getBlockByNumber latest gave 0x31df6e2 a moment earlier, and GASLIMIT returned 0x1c9c380 (30,000,000) against a block gasLimit of 0x2dc6c0 (3,000,000). eth_estimateGas to 0x01 with empty data gave 0x8e0a (36,362) against 0x52bc (21,180) for 0x04, which fits a 15,000 gas ECRECOVER. The context claim holds. One detail is incomplete: the item counts three gas reads, but the bytecode also has a STATICCALL, which is the high-level balanceOf in Currency.balanceOfSelf (src/types/Currency.sol:94, used at src/PoolManager.sol:285 and :359). That call also forwards all gas and reverts the caller on failure, so the conclusion is unchanged.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Precompile repricing and the 30,000,000 gas eth_call context on chain 999 change no result of src/, because every gas read forwards all remaining gas and a failure reverts the whole transaction.
clearedSpotChecks.note: Read src/types/Currency.sol:44-53 (native transfer: call(gas(),...) then bubbleUpAndRevertWith on failure), :55-86 (ERC20 transfer: success requires call success and a return of exactly 1 or empty, revert otherwise), :90-96 (balanceOfSelf is a Solidity high-level view call that reverts on failure) and src/libraries/Hooks.sol:131-137 (callHook reverts on !success). No call in src/ tolerates a failed subcall, so an out-of-gas subcall cannot let execution continue with a different value. The bytecode holds no STATICCALL to an address below 0x100 that could be a precompile in the source, and src/ names none. A simulation in a 30,000,000 gas context that fails in a 3,000,000 gas block only reverts that transaction.

clearedSpotChecks.note: The raw file research/network-risk/cycles/024/theme-hyperevm-call-path.work/raw/replica_purroof.json records compared, equal and an empty mismatch list. A fresh batched read on both endpoints (blocks 0x31df6f0 and 0x31df6f1) gave the same PoolManager native balance 0x9d908ef23bc0864f and slot 0 (owner 0x2d09d0c2f82c59b19b3c65a48ce2c550bf0921f9). Latest base fee read was 0x7021faa (117,579,690 wei) and eth_gasPrice 0x6c337a6, consistent with an ordinary account being unable to send a gas price 0 transaction. PoolManager nonce is 0x1. The item proves agreement of the replica with the official RPC, which the earlier item shows is itself revm; it does not prove agreement with the closed validator, which the open medium lead already records.
